Generic plotting functions
```{r}
# plot function
plotModuleTraitAssociation <- function(lmOutput, module, trait, plotType, plotTitle=NULL, moduleColour = NULL) {
  # whether to colour by module colour or a prespecified colour
  if (is.null(moduleColour)) {
    fillColour <- module_colours[[module]]
  } else {
    fillColour <- moduleColour
  }
  # create df with desired module and trait
  trait_df <- lmOutput %>%
    filter(module == {{ module }}) %>%
    left_join(meta[, c("study_id", trait)], by = "study_id")
  # plot
  p <- trait_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = !!sym(trait), y = eigengene)) +
    labs(y = "Eigenprotein", title = plotTitle)
  if (plotType == "category") {
    # report linear model output
    stats <- lm(reformulate(termlabels = trait, response = "eigengene"), data = trait_df)
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(aes(colour=!!sym(trait)), width=0.25) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5,width=0.5) +
      geom_richtext(data = tidy(stats) %>% filter(!term == "(Intercept)"), aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = paste0(
        "β = ", round(estimate, 2), "<br>",
        formatPvalLabel(p.value, includeP = T)
      )), vjust = 0.75, fill = NA, label.color = NA, size = 3) +
      coord_cartesian(clip="off") +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25)))
  }  else if (plotType == "numeric") {
    # report Pearson's r
    stats <- tidy(cor.test(reformulate(c("eigengene", trait)), data = trait_df))
    cor_sign <- if_else(stats$estimate>0,"pos","neg")
    p <- p +
      geom_point(colour = fillColour) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "grey30") +
      geom_richtext(data = stats, aes(x = Inf, y = if_else(cor_sign=="pos", -Inf, Inf), label = paste0(
        "<i>r</i> = ", round(estimate, 2), "<br>",
        formatPvalLabel(p.value, includeP = T)
      )), vjust = if_else(cor_sign=="pos", 0, 1), hjust = 1, fill = NA, label.color = NA, size = 3)
  } else {
    message("plotType should be category / numeric.")
  }
  output <- list(stats = stats, plot = p)
  return(output)
}


plotModuleConnectivityTrait <- function(traitResults, statColumn, connectivityDf, module, wgcnaObjectColors,
                                         plotTitle = NULL, moduleColour = NULL) {
  # whether to colour by module colour or a prespecified colour
  if (is.null(moduleColour)) {
    fillColour <- module_colours[[module]]
  } else {
    fillColour <- moduleColour
  }
  yLabel <- paste0(module, " connectivity")
  # for dplyr filtering
  module <- enquo(module)
  # column to use in place of "t" (as a symbol, for tidy evaluation)
  statColumn <- rlang::sym(statColumn)
  # just keep module members
  membership_df <- data.frame(apt_id = names(wgcnaObjectColors), module = paste0("ME", wgcnaObjectColors)) %>%
    filter(module == {{ module }})
  # merge into one df
  df <- connectivityDf %>%
    filter(module == {{ module }}) %>%
    filter(apt_id %in% membership_df$apt_id) %>%
    left_join(traitResults, by = "apt_id")


  stats <- tidy(cor.test(df$pearson, df %>% pull(!!statColumn)))
  cor_sign <- if_else(stats$estimate > 0, "pos", "neg")
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = !!statColumn, y = pearson)) +
    geom_point(colour=fillColour) +
    geom_richtext(data = stats,
                aes(x = Inf, y = if_else(cor_sign == "pos", -Inf, Inf), label = paste0(
                  "<i>r</i> = ", round(estimate,2), "<br>",
                  formatPvalLabel(p.value))),
vjust = if_else(cor_sign=="pos", 0, 1), hjust = 1, size = 3, fill = NA, label.color = NA) +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", colour="grey30") +
    labs(y = yLabel, fill = NULL, title = plotTitle) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_markdown())
  return(list(df = df, plot = p))
}

plotModuleORA <- function(oraDF, module, showTopN = NULL, title = NULL, yLabSize = 10, yLabWrap = 30) {
  df <- oraDF %>%
    filter(module == {{ module }}) %>%
    filter(fdr < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(p.value)
  if (!is.null(showTopN)) {
    df <- df %>% slice_head(n = showTopN)
  }
  ggplot(df, aes(x = -log10(fdr), y = fct_reorder(geneset, fdr, .desc = TRUE))) +
    geom_col(fill = "grey75", colour = "black") +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(yLabWrap)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = title) +
    labs(x = "-log<sub>10</sub>(FDR <i>P</i>)", y = NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = yLabSize))
}
```

# Set up coabundance network
Import WGCNA object
```{r}
net <- readRDS(here("02_protein_modules/data/network.rds"))
# assign colours
aptamer_colours <- labels2colors(net$colors)

# import module connectivity
# Here connectivity essentially refers to the relationship between the protein
# abundance (residualised against covariates) and the module eigenprotein.
module_connectivity <- read_parquet(here("02_protein_modules/data/connectivity.parquet"))

# Assigning biological definitions to modules
# Used one-sided Fisher's test to assess enrichment of module members with gene sets.
geneset_ora <- readRDS(here("02_protein_modules/data/geneset_ora.wgcna_modules.rds"))
```


Soft thresholding power plots
```{r fig.height=6.5, fig.width=6}
sft <- readRDS(here("02_protein_modules/data/soft_thresholding.rds"))
# power used
sft$power
# plots
figs$signed_r2 <- sft$sft %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Power, y = model_fit)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Power), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.85, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Soft threshold (power)", y = "Signed R<sup>2</sup>") +
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")
figs$mean_connectivity <- sft$sft %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Power, y = mean.k.)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Power), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.75) +
  labs(x = "Soft threshold (power)", y = "Mean connectivity") +
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")
figs$signed_r2 / figs$mean_connectivity
```
A power of `{r} sft$power` was used.

### Module info
How many aptamers in each module?
```{r}
table(aptamer_colours)
```
Extract module members
```{r}
module_members <- data.frame(module=net$colors) %>%
  mutate(module=paste0("ME",module)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("apt_id")
```


We can also compare modules based on their eigenproteins.
First calculate a dissimilarity measure between the module eigenproteins (preserving the sign of the correlation).
Remove module 0 as this contains SOMAmers that were not assigned a module.
```{r}
module_dend <- dendro_data(as.dendrogram(hclust(as.dist((1 - t(cor(net$MEs[, !(colnames(net$MEs) == "ME0")], method = "p"))) / 2), method = "average")))
```
Before plotting we can extract the module colours which will be the basis for future plots.
```{r}
module_colours <- aptamer_colours
names(module_colours) <- paste0("ME", net$colors)
module_colours <- module_colours[unique(names(module_colours))]
# remove module 0
module_colours <- module_colours[!names(module_colours) == "ME0"]

# replace light cyan as you can't see it
#module_colours[module_colours == "lightcyan"] <- "darkcyan"
module_colours[module_colours == "white"] <- "ivory3"
module_colours[module_colours == "lightyellow"] <- "gold"
# set module order
module_order <- module_dend$labels$label
```


```{r fig.height=0.3, fig.width=6}
figs$module_colours <- data.frame(module_colours) %>%
  rownames_to_column("module") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_relevel(module, module_order), y = "blank")) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = module)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = module_colours) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.01, 0.1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  figTheme("box") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
```

Hierarchical module clustering
```{r fig.height=2, fig.width=3}
figs$module_dendrogram <- ggplot(module_dend$segments) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0.01, 0.1), breaks = label(module_dend)$x,
    labels = label(module_dend)$label, guide = guide_axis(angle = 90)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

# Association between modules and clinical measures

```{r}
# extract module eigengenes as a dataframe
lm_df <- net$MEs %>%
  rownames_to_column("study_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !study_id, names_to = "module", values_to = "eigengene") %>%
  # remove module 0 as these are unassigned SOMAmers
  filter(!module == "ME0")

# create a dataframe containing the clinical measures we're interested in
traits <- meta %>% select(study_id, ref_dx, platelets, baseline_esr, baseline_crp, pmryesno, cranial_isch_comp_rm)
# # also add on disease histology measures
# histology <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/meta.histology.rds")) %>%
#   select(study_id, max_barcelona_score_recode, max_media_pattern_recode, max_media_destruction_recode, max_occlusion_grade_recode) %>%
#   distinct()
# traits <- traits %>% left_join(histology, by = "study_id")
# the colnames except study id are therefore the traits being tested
trait_list <- names(traits)
trait_list <- trait_list[!trait_list == "study_id"]
# fit linear model to test association between module eigengenes and each respective clinical measure
trait_associations <- map(trait_list, \(trait) lm_df %>%
  left_join(traits, by = "study_id") %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  do(glance(lm(reformulate(termlabels = trait, response = "eigengene"), data = .)))) %>%
  set_names(trait_list) %>%
  list_rbind(names_to = "trait")
# correct for multiple testing (pool results together)
trait_associations <- trait_associations %>%
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))
```


Asterisk indicates FDR < 0.05
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=9}
figs$module_trait_associations <- trait_associations %>%
  mutate(
    # categorise traits for plotting
    category = case_when(trait == "ref_dx" ~ "Diagnosis",
      trait %in% c("platelets", "baseline_esr", "baseline_crp") ~ "Inflammatory markers",
      trait %in% c("pmryesno", "cranial_isch_comp_rm") ~ "Clinical symptoms",
      trait %in% c(
        "max_barcelona_score_recode", "max_media_destruction_recode",
        "max_media_pattern_recode", "max_occlusion_grade_recode"
      ) ~ "Temporal artery histology",
      .default = "no_cat"
    ),
    # relabel traits for plotting
    trait = case_match(trait,
      "ref_dx" ~ "GCA",
      "platelets" ~ "Platelet count",
      "baseline_esr" ~ "ESR",
      "baseline_crp" ~ "CRP",
      "pmryesno" ~ "PMR",
      "cranial_isch_comp_rm" ~ "Cranial ischaemia",
      "max_barcelona_score_recode" ~ "Hernández-Rodríguez et al",
      "max_media_destruction_recode" ~ "Media destruction",
      "max_media_pattern_recode" ~ "Media inflammation pattern",
      "max_occlusion_grade_recode" ~ "Intima occlusion grade",
      .default = trait
    ),
    trait = factor(trait, levels = c(
      "GCA", "CRP", "ESR","Platelet count",
      "PMR", "Cranial ischaemia",
      "Hernández-Rodríguez et al", "Media destruction", "Media inflammation pattern", "Intima occlusion grade"
    )),
    asterisk = if_else(fdr < 0.05, "*", NA)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_relevel(module, module_order), y = trait)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = -log10(fdr)), colour="white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = asterisk), colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  facet_col(~ factor(category, levels = c("Diagnosis", "Inflammatory markers", "Clinical symptoms", "Temporal artery histology")), scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "-log<sub>10</sub>(FDR <i>P</i>)") +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), limits = rev) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), guide = guide_axis(angle = 90)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(direction = 1, guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black")) +
  figTheme("box")

figs$module_trait_associations
```

## Connectivity

Visualise most important SOMAmers in modules 19 and 23
```{r}
topConnectedProteins <- function(ME,nProteinLabels,proportionOfProteins,xLabel){
  require(ggrepel)
  df <- module_members |> filter(module==ME) |>
    left_join(module_connectivity,by=c("apt_id", "module")) |>
    left_join(select(protein_info,apt_id,EntrezGeneSymbol),by="apt_id") |>
    arrange(desc(pearson)) |>
    mutate(rank=dense_rank(desc(pearson)))
  df |>
    head(proportionOfProteins*nrow(df)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = rank,y=pearson)) +
    geom_point(colour=module_colours[[ME]]) +
    geom_text_repel(data=head(df,nProteinLabels),aes(label=EntrezGeneSymbol), min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf,size=3,bg.colour = "white") +
    labs(x = xLabel, y= paste0(ME, " connectivity"))
}
```

```{r}
(figs$top_module_somamers <- topConnectedProteins(ME = "ME19", nProteinLabels = 15, proportionOfProteins = 0.5,xLabel = "Ranked SOMAmers (top 50%)") +
topConnectedProteins(ME = "ME23", nProteinLabels = 15, proportionOfProteins = 0.5,xLabel = "Ranked SOMAmers (top 50%)"))
```

## Supp
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
(((figs$signed_r2 | figs$mean_connectivity) / figs$module_connectivity_trait_association + plot_layout(heights = c(1,3))) |
  figs$module_biological_definition) + plot_layout(widths = c(3.5,1))
ggsave(here("figures/raw/supp_wgcna_supporting.pdf"), height = 8, width = 14)
```

Export  module members with colours + connectivity for supp data
```{r}
module_members |>
  filter(!module=="ME0") |>
  left_join(data.frame(module_colours) |> rownames_to_column("module") |> rename(module_colour=module_colours),by="module") |>
  left_join(module_connectivity,by=c("apt_id","module")) |>
  select(-pval) |>
  rename(connectivity=pearson) |>
  write_csv(here("supp_data/protein_module_info.csv"))
```
